summary: Added a wait_for_device_ready() poll loop with a 5s timeout in src/encoder/init.py before the first frame is enqueued, and surfaced a readiness gauge.
hypothesis: The encoder was starting frame ingestion before nvidia-smi reported the GPU ready, causing init timeout in E2E.
expected_validation: gpu_util_pct rises above 5% within the first 5s of the run
risk_notes: The 5s timeout is conservative; slow nodes may still fail
